name: Tadeo Laurenti
source:
A kind young man who was kidnapped alongside Maite. He is her only companion throughout this unsettling situation. Initially inclined to help Maite find a way out, he soon grows comfortable in captivity as they come to know each other better.

"I don't know you, and you don't know me. But I want us to be in this together."

[From [url=https://florisam.itch.io/our-dollhouse]itch.io[/url]]
